headline: Davis & Elkins put seven past Point Park
dek: Three days after winning at Concord, Point Park lost by seven clear goals at Davis & Elkins, the widest margin between conference sides since Charleston beat West Virginia Wesleyan by ten. Davis & Elkins have conceded eight goals in sixteen matches all season.
displaced_by: Davis & Elkins beat Point Park by seven, three days after Point Park's win at Concord made the standing headline

pattern.text: Charleston have scored more goals than West Liberty and Wheeling together, and sixteen different players have shared their fifty-two; the scoring is spread, not carried.

wire.line: Davis & Elkins have lost only once all season, and no other conference side has beaten Charleston.
